minutes.headline: Charter Review Committee worked through Charter sections on town meetings, elected offices and board powers; no votes.
minutes.summary: The committee reviewed draft Charter language on two annual town meetings, the deputy moderator, Finance Committee eligibility, vacancies, recall, the name selectmen versus select board, and appointments. Members also discussed how elected boards oversee staff such as the land use director, and the School Committee's duties. No formal votes were recorded; meeting dates for December were set.

budget_items.what_was_said: Discussion that who pays the attorney to renegotiate the cable license was a budgeting issue, not a Charter issue, and had not been in the committee's budget.
Members noted the Charter allows compensation for elected officials as appropriated, and that administering it may cost more than it is worth.

decisions.decision: Next meeting continues work on Charter section three; the town manager section is to be taken up at a later meeting once the town manager's availability is confirmed, possibly January.
Members agreed to seek feedback from boards and to put School Committee Charter language on a future agenda.
The select board naming question was to be considered for a survey rather than settled now.
